title: Attention cues: optional sound, a brighter tab, and session and project tabs that blink together
summary: An optional beep (off by default) when a terminal needs you, a brighter red needs-input glow, and the zoom-strip tab and project tab of a terminal back from parking blink yellow in step, re-synced when a hidden project is shown.

deferred.what: The blink phase is fixed once at render, but the browser restarts a CSS animation when React moves a keyed tab's DOM node; moving a blinking project tab (keyboard move or drag) makes it blink out of step with its zoom tab (measured 461 ms off in Chromium) until the terminal is selected.
deferred.why: The robust fix changes the mechanism (re-align each element's getAnimations() start time to the shared clock in a layout effect); out of scope for the confirming round.
